question: Under a restore-style burst, how far is Silica's scheduler (B1) from a makespan lower bound, and where does the time go?
system: 1 reader, 8 rows x 80 slots, 8 Zone shuttles (one row each), buffer 8, contention hold 0.5 s (IOConfig defaults)
workload: 400 file reads arriving at t=0; sizes from SILICA_SIZE_MIX (Silica SOSP'23 section 2 shares)
scenario_note: restore_kN spreads the files over N random platters (Silica spreads a platter-set apart, section 6); independent puts every file on its own random platter
drop_rule: If B1 is within 10% of the lower bound (median gap_vs_lb < 0.10) in every scenario, there is no scheduling headroom and the direction is dropped.
lower_bound_note: The bound ignores empty repositioning, congestion and gate queuing, so part of any gap is unreachable; time breakdowns say which part.
